6783.title: Command metadata lost during provider translation
6783.rootCauseOneLine: Bash classification drops description, and command completion maps every error to exit code 1 instead of parsing its result header.
6783.proposedFix: Use the existing presentation title for descriptions and parse a validated leading failure exit-code header, retaining command text and 0/1 fallbacks.
6783.caveats: Deterministic translation replay, not live UI/CLI verification. Six unrelated baseline discovery/permission tests fail in this environment; all 320 scoped tests pass after the local fix.
